title: patch_file fails on long README table rows
description: Four consecutive patch_file calls failed when inserting or removing rows in .moeb/README.md. All failures returned 'All context lines appear in the file' with no further disambiguation. The root cause appears to be that very long table row lines (500+ characters) cause hunk relocation or diffy apply to malfunction. A write_file fallback was required to complete the README update, producing two tool_errors in RunState.
proposed_resolution: Investigate whether diffy has a line-length limit or whether relocate_hunk_positions malfunctions with very long context lines. Add a regression test for patch_file with 500+ character table row content similar to the moeb README index.
